_note: SessionVault model links — SINGLE source of truth. Web app (Next.js) and Flutter APK both read these same links, so adding/changing a link here never messes up the other app. Do NOT copy these URLs into page.tsx or Flutter code — import/read this file instead. Verified live 2026-11-27 (both resolve URLs return a download redirect).

models.download: download the whole repo (huggingface-cli download shamim1122/whisper-small-bangla-onnx) — a single-file link does not work for this one
models.file: (whole repo — multiple .onnx files, not one file)
models.note: Does not output timestamps — long audio must be split into short pieces before transcribing.

optional_own_repo.name: oshiur/sessionvault-models
optional_own_repo.status: not created yet — optional, only if we later copy the models into our own repo. Must be Public, otherwise app users cannot download from it.

ui_rule: AI Setup popup shows NO model names, sizes or details — only 'AI Setup', one overall progress bar with live %, and Continue when done. Model names/sizes live ONLY in this file.
